hero.headline: Our Menus
hero.subheadline: Build your own bowl with our signature bases, proteins, sauces, and toppers. Everything made fresh, never reheated.

buildYourBowl.headline: Build Your Own Bowl
buildYourBowl.subheadline: Contact us for a custom quote tailored to your event
buildYourBowl.intro: Our core catering selections mirror the fresh, crowd-pleasing rustic rice bowls featured on our rotating retail menu — ensuring the same high-quality, customizable dishes your guests already love.
buildYourBowl.customNote: We specialize in crafting menus tailored precisely to your event's vision. Whether it's dietary preferences, theme-specific flavors, or a completely unique creation, just tell us what you're dreaming of — we're a "yes" company and we'll make it happen!

toppersSection.title: Step 4: Top It Off
toppersSection.note: We make toppers for any occasion or themes.

appetizersSection.headline: Appetizers
appetizersSection.subheadline: Custom Appetizers Tailored Just for You
appetizersSection.intro: We're passionate about personalizing our appetizers to perfectly match your event — and we know from experience that these crowd-pleasing bites always deliver big smiles.

themedBarsSection.headline: BYO Themed Bars
themedBarsSection.subheadline: Interactive food stations for your guests

softDrinksSection.headline: Soft Drinks
softDrinksSection.intro: We can provide any soft drink combination you would like for your event. This strictly comes down to your budget and how fancy you want to get.

dessertsSection.headline: Desserts
dessertsSection.intro: We do not typically make our desserts and leave it to the local experts. We have plenty of Denver vendors that we have long standing relationships with. We just need to discuss what you want for your event!

appetizers.name: Artisan Grazing Table
appetizers.description: Stunning spreads of cheeses, fresh seasonal fruits and vegetables, artisanal crackers, gourmet dips, nuts, and hand-selected accompaniments — beautifully arranged for effortless, interactive grazing that wows guests from the first glance.

appetizers.name: Caprese Skewers
appetizers.description: Light and refreshing, fresh mozzarella, sliced grape tomato, and fresh basil, skewered for a perfect bite (2 per guest).

appetizers.name: Crudité and Hummus
